newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba's Palm sees better chance of timely EMU start.
newsitem.headline: Buba's Palm sees better chance of timely EMU start.

text.p: Bundesbank council member Guntram Palm said on Monday that he believed chances for a timely start to European monetary union were better than ever following this weekend's EU finance ministers meeting.

In a summary of a speech to be made to an internal meeting in the regional central bank in Baden-Wuerttemberg, of which he is president, Palm said that it was clear that EMU preparations were now well on track.

"If approporiate consolidation efforts are adopted on national budgets (he) would now expect more than ever that there will be a punctual start," the summary from the bank, which used reported speech, quoted Palm as saying.
